comments.snippet:
Thank you for the screenshot and the log; the `192` DPI line in it is what this change is based on.

Nightly `1.84.0+f7ff789c90` (https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly) changes how the title bar of a regular PuTTY is hidden: it was pushed out of the tab by fixed amounts that fit a 100% display, and it is now measured on the PuTTY window itself.
We could not reproduce this here: we have no setup with a regular PuTTY at 200% scaling, so only the calculation was tested, not...
